title: CapabilityRecord
description: A single capability entry in a Format Factory capability map. Represents one named operation for one format in one product profile.

format.description: Format identifier, e.g. FODS, FODG, ABW

format_family.description: Format family, e.g. odf_flat, netpbm, spreadsheet_text

product_type.description: Product track. commercial = .NET commercial; foss_reduced = Python FOSS

product_profile.description: Specific product profile name, e.g. fods-dotnet-v1, abw-python-foss

capability_name.description: Human-readable capability name, e.g. Load FODS file

operation_kind.description: Specific operation kind, e.g. load_file, export_csv, probe_format

input_cardinality.description: Number of inputs the operation accepts

output_cardinality.description: Number of outputs the operation produces

expected_for_commercial.description: Whether this capability is expected for the commercial product track

expected_for_foss.description: Whether this capability is expected for the FOSS/reduced product track

required_for_poc.description: Whether this capability is required for POC readiness

blocks_readiness.description: Whether absence of this capability blocks product readiness

authority_state.description: Source of authority for this capability

spec_refs.description: Spec fact IDs or fact file paths

requirement_refs.description: Requirement IDs or requirement file paths

dogfood_refs.description: Dogfood output file paths or library references

evidence_refs.description: Evidence artifact paths (test logs, sample outputs, gate reports)

next_task_candidate.description: Suggested next taskcard or work item to advance this capability

ai_involvement_flag.description: Whether AI was involved in generating this record. If true, record needs independent verification.

manual_agent_verified.description: Whether the agent manually opened and inspected source artifacts for this record

verifier.description: Verifier identity (agent ID, sprint ID, or human)

$comment: RULE: ai_involvement_flag=true AND current_state in verified states = VIOLATION. Must use validate_capability_map.py to enforce.
